findings.description: When the CA bundle path does not exist, the code now only emits a warning instead of raising OSError, and the removed extract_zipped_paths call means zipped installs now hit this path.
findings.rationale: Trigger: requests is loaded from a zip archive (or the bundle is otherwise missing) with verify left at its default, so DEFAULT_CA_BUNDLE_PATH points into the archive and os.path.exists returns False. The changed code only warns and continues with a nonexistent cert_loc, so the request proceeds to TLS setup with an invalid CA path. Impact: the user gets a warning and then an obscure SSL failure later, instead of the clear OSError that previously explained the missing bundle, and the zip-extraction fallback that made this work is gone.
